EditorMetadata.Comment: E2: a blueprint AiPrimitive CONDITION composed as a host-BTree node — the condition-side mirror of T31_ComposedAiPrimitive. Params (RunsNeeded) are bin-packed into BrainBlackboard at the baked offset; WorkingState (Ticks) lives in a BlueprintBlackboard* partition slot keyed by FNV-1a(assetId, nodeVisualId) and is provisioned by BehaviorIngressSystem — the SAME partition-slot rail as the composed action, because edge-detection/hysteresis conditions need cross-tick memory too. Dispatches to DemoAiPrimitiveNodes.TickCore each tick, comparing the result against NodeStatus.Success: Failure for the first (RunsNeeded-1) ticks, then Success from tick RunsNeeded onward (WorkingState.Ticks keeps incrementing even while the condition reports Failure, proving the slot persists rather than being re-zeroed).

Variables.Name: bpParams
Variables.Comment: Authored params for the composed blueprint condition. RunsNeeded=3 -> the node reports Failure on ticks 1-2 and Success from tick 3 onward.
